chapter: Duo with Bucky and the seven-string
title: How the seven-string works
summary: Using the low string for bass notes under chords, and not overcomplicating it.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Doing more bass lines with that?

Yeah. You play the chord and so if you had a D minor chord, now the bass note was an octave lower than where it would be on the regular A string because of the low A. And then you could [scats]. So the “ja” is the chord [scats]. And it was great. It was so simple and it’s still — a lot of guys get too wrapped up in harmonizing the seventh string. Don’t worry about it. Don’t use it for anything but that kind of stuff. Playing great chord melodies and things. That’s what it was for you know.
